title: Mailbox/get total_emails underflows for empty group (lo > hi)
description: server.rs route_method Mailbox/get computes total_emails as (hi - lo + 1) as u32 from list_groups() return values. If a group has no articles, lo=1 and hi=0 (conventional empty range). The expression hi - lo + 1 cast to u32 produces 0 correctly if using i64 arithmetic, but if the types are u64, subtraction wraps. Regardless of type, callers relying on this producing 0 for an empty group need a saturating_sub or explicit max(0) guard — the current code lacks that.
